## What changes

## Documentation (.github/DOCUMENTATION.md)

- [ ] The manual page of every changed behaviour is updated.
- [ ] `CHANGES.md` lists the change, with **Action needed** if users must act.
- [ ] The guide still matches what a person sees.
- [ ] Examples use made-up names only.

## Security (.github/SECURE-CODING.md)

- [ ] Reads, writes, programs started and network use follow the rules.
- [ ] A new parser or format has a fuzz target.
- [ ] SECURITY.md still describes what the code does.
